name: vlaakith clvii
lore:
High atop the drifting city of Tu’narath, nested within the ribcage of a dead god, dwells the Lich-Queen Vlaakith CLVII. She is a biological anomaly: a githyanki who has defied the timeless stagnation of the Astral Plane through the profane rites of undeath.

Her "ecology" is one of predatory divinity. She sustains her withered, desiccated form not with food or sleep, but by devouring the potent souls of her most accomplished warriors under the guise of "Ascension." Behaviorally, she is a creature of absolute paranoia and icy calculation. She views her subjects as mere fuel for her immortality and the multiverse as a throne yet unclaimed. To look upon her is to see a star-starved void wrapped in gold and silk—a queen who has long since traded the warmth of blood for the cold, eternal silence of godhood.
